hook: PocketDisplayJoe turns an iPhone into a second display
hookText: PocketDisplayJoe turns an iPhone into a second display

beats.say: PocketDisplayJoe is an open-source Swift and SwiftUI app that creates a virtual monitor sized to the iPhone screen at 60 fps over USB or encrypted Wi-Fi, with touch working as a mouse.
The pipeline is ScreenCaptureKit to VideoToolbox HEVC and hardware decoding on the phone.
Wi-Fi uses TLS with a pre-shared key and only paired devices, with no accounts, cloud or analytics.
